If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days and forecast is rising, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is falling, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is peaking, reduce forecast by 2–4% for late horizon (16–30 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is flat, increase forecast by 1–3% for mid horizon (8–15 days).  
If sentiment is >0.67 and forecast is below 78.00, add 0.5–1.0% to forecast for early horizon (1–7 days).  
If sentiment is <0.33 and forecast is above 78.00, subtract 0.5–1.0% for late horizon (16–30 days).
